name: MKM Digital Connector for passFLY.PRO
author: dgmaximiliano

sections.description:
MKM Digital Connector for passFLY.PRO connects your WordPress website with the passFLY.PRO digital pass and ticketing platform.

It seamlessly integrates with popular WordPress form builders (Elementor Forms, WPForms, Contact Form 7, and Gravity Forms) to automatically generate digital tickets for Apple Wallet (.pkpass) and Google Wallet.

When an attendee registers through your website form, this plugin creates a branded digital pass complete with a unique QR code for real-time check-in. The attendee can instantly add the pass to their smartphone wallet, receive automated SMS/Email confirmations, or access a split-screen mobile pass landing page.

Key Features

  • Apple Wallet & Google Wallet Passes: Native digital passes with live push updates.
  • Instant Form Integration: Native support for Elementor Pro Forms, WPForms, Contact Form 7, and Gravity Forms.
  • Real-time Mobile Scanner: Staff check-in scanner accessible via magic link with camera QR reader.
  • Split-Screen Landing Pages: Responsive landing page displaying pass download links and QR codes.
  • Automated Reminders: Scheduled email/SMS reminders before the event starts.
  • Offline Resilient Queue: Background retry queue ensuring zero lost registrations even during temporary connectivity drops.
  • Clean Database Hygiene: Opt-in total data cleanup upon uninstallation.

Important: Reliance on Third-Party Service

This plugin is a connector to the passFLY.PRO SaaS platform (https://passfly.pro).

In order to securely sign Apple Wallet (.pkpass) and Google Wallet passes, encrypt pass certificates, send transactional SMS/Email notifications, and synchronize check-in scanner data, the plugin transmits attendee information to the passFLY external API.

  • Data Transmitted: Attendee Name, Surname, Email address, Phone number, and Event registration details.
  • Third-Party Service: passFLY.PRO
  • Terms of Service: https://passfly.pro/terms/
  • Privacy Policy: https://passfly.pro/dichiarazione-sulla-privacy-ue/
  • Cookie Policy: https://passfly.pro/cookie-policy-ue/

A free passFLY account is required. When registering directly from the plugin settings page, you receive 10 free tickets/SMS to test all features. Additional ticket packs can be purchased through your passFLY account.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the mkm-digital-connector-for-passfly folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to passFLY > Licenza & Ricariche in your WordPress admin menu.
  4. Register your profile (B2B Agency or B2C Individual) to receive 10 free test credits, or enter your existing API Key.
  5. Create your event under passFLY > Nuovo Evento and map your form fields.
sections.faq:
Do I need a passFLY account?

Yes. You can register for a free account directly within the plugin admin page under Licenza & Ricariche and receive 10 free credits to test the service.

Which form plugins are supported?

passFLY supports Elementor Pro Forms, WPForms, Contact Form 7, and Gravity Forms out of the box.

How do staff members scan tickets at the door?

Under the Licenza & Ricariche settings or inside each event, you will find a Magic Link SCANNER. Share this link with your staff to turn any smartphone browser into a camera QR code scanner with zero app installation needed.

Does this plugin leave orphan data in the database when deleted?

No. passFLY adheres to clean database standards. You can enable the “Elimina tutti i dati” option in settings to ensure complete removal of options and queues upon uninstallation.
